name: IBANDRONIC ACID 150 MG 1 TABLET
description: Ibandronic acid 150 mg in a 1-tablet presentation. It is primarily used to treat and prevent postmenopausal osteoporosis, a disease that weakens bones and increases the risk of fractures. It belongs to a class of medications called bisphosphonates.
